declarations.name: Alert
declarations.description: Displays a prominent message about status or a required action.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra class names appended to the root element.

inputs.name: dismissible
inputs.description: Whether a dismiss control is shown.

inputs.name: onDismiss
inputs.description: Called when the alert is dismissed via its dismiss control.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Action buttons shown alongside the message.

cssProperties.name: --tb-alert-accent
cssProperties.description: Accent colour of the leading rule.

semantics.notes: Announces an important message in place; does not steal focus.

examples.title: Dismissible error

declarations.name: Avatar
declarations.description: Represents a person or entity as an image or initials.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra class names appended to the root element.

inputs.name: src
inputs.description: Image source; falls back to initials when absent.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Accessible name for the depicted person or entity.

semantics.notes: Identifies a person or entity; `name` is the accessible name.

examples.title: Image with initials fallback
examples.source: const who = <Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" src="/ada.png" size="large" shape="circle" />;

declarations.name: Badge
declarations.description: A compact count or status marker attached to another element.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra class names appended to the root element.

inputs.name: solid
inputs.description: Whether the badge renders as a filled pill rather than an outline.

semantics.notes: Annotates a nearby element with a count or status; never interactive.

examples.title: Status marker
examples.source: const shipped = <Badge tone="success" solid>Shipped</Badge>;

declarations.name: Button
declarations.description: Triggers a single action when activated.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra class names appended to the root element.

inputs.name: onPress
inputs.description: Called when the button is activated by pointer or keyboard.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Leading icon rendered before the label.

semantics.notes: Triggers the action named by its label; not for navigation.

examples.title: Primary action
examples.source: const save = <Button variant="primary" onPress={() => console.log('saved')}>Save</Button>;

examples.title: Disabled secondary
examples.source: const cancel = <Button variant="secondary" size="small" disabled>Cancel</Button>;

declarations.name: Card
declarations.description: Groups related content on a raised surface.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra class names appended to the root element.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Heading shown at the top of the card.

inputs.name: elevation
inputs.description: Elevation step, 0–3; higher casts a deeper shadow.

inputs.name: interactive
inputs.description: Whether the card responds to pointer interaction.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Actions shown at the bottom of the card.

semantics.notes: Groups related content as one unit; the title names the group.

examples.title: Interactive summary card

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra class names appended to the root element.

inputs.name: hint
inputs.description: Explanatory text shown below the control.

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: Validation message; presence puts the field in its error state.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Whether the control must be filled before submission.

inputs.name: indeterminate
inputs.description: Whether the box shows the mixed state.

inputs.name: onCheckedChange
inputs.description: Called with the new checked state when the box is toggled.

semantics.notes: One independent on/off choice; use a radio group for exclusive choices.

examples.title: Consent checkbox
Mixed "select all" state
examples.source: const selectAll = <Checkbox label="Select all" indeterminate />;

declarations.name: Combobox
declarations.description: A text input paired with a filterable list of options, optionally loaded on demand.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra class names appended to the root element.

inputs.name: hint
inputs.description: Explanatory text shown below the control.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Whether the control must be filled before submission.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Options shown when no loader is supplied.

inputs.name: multiple
inputs.description: Whether the list allows more than one choice.

inputs.name: filterable
inputs.description: Whether the control filters its options as the user types.

inputs.name: noResultsMessage
inputs.description: Message shown when no option matches the query.

inputs.name: loadOptions
inputs.description: Fetches options for a query; makes the control async.

inputs.name: onValueChange
inputs.description: Called with the chosen value when the selection changes.

inputs.name: onInputValueChange
inputs.description: Called with the typed text on every keystroke.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Moves keyboard focus into the text input.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the option list without changing the selection.

cssProperties.name: --tb-combobox-list-max-height
cssProperties.description: Maximum height of the option list.

semantics.notes: Text input paired with a list of suggestions; the input owns the value.

examples.title: Static options
Async loading

declarations.name: DataTable
declarations.description:
A sortable, selectable, paginated table for tabular data.

The kit's most complex component: generic column definitions, an imperative handle,
projected header and toolbar content, and callback props for every state change.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra class names appended to the root element.

inputs.name: selectionMode
inputs.description: How many rows may be selected at once.

inputs.name: selection
inputs.description: Ids of the currently selected rows.

inputs.name: rowClass
inputs.description: Resolver returning a CSS class for a given row.

inputs.name: onSelectionChange
inputs.description: Called when the selected row set changes.

inputs.name: onRowActivate
inputs.description: Called when a row is activated by double-click or Enter.

inputs.name: onSortChange
inputs.description: Called when the user changes the active column sort.

inputs.name: page
inputs.description: Zero-based index of the visible page.

inputs.name: onPageChange
inputs.description: Called with the new page index when the user paginates.

methods.name: focusFirstCell
methods.description: Moves keyboard focus to the first focusable cell.

methods.name: selectAllVisible
methods.description: Selects every row on the current page.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears the selection without emitting a change.

methods.name: scrollToRow
methods.description: Scrolls a row into view; resolves once the scroll settles.

semantics.notes: Two-dimensional tabular data with selectable, activatable rows.

examples.title: Typed columns and rows
Multi-select with pagination
Empty state and projected toolbar

declarations.name: Dialog
declarations.description: A modal dialog that traps focus while open.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra class names appended to the root element.

inputs.name: open
inputs.description: Whether the dialog is currently shown.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Width preset of the dialog panel.

inputs.name: dismissOnBackdrop
inputs.description: Whether clicking the backdrop dismisses the dialog.

inputs.name: dismissOnEscape
inputs.description: Whether pressing Escape dismisses the dialog.

inputs.name: onDismiss
inputs.description: Called with the reason when the dialog closes.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Action buttons shown at the bottom of the panel.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the dialog and moves focus into it.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the dialog, returning focus to the invoker.

methods.name: settled
methods.description: Resolves once the closing transition has finished.

semantics.notes: Modal surface that traps focus; use alertdialog for destructive confirmations.

examples.title: Confirmation dialog
Fullscreen editor

declarations.name: Form
declarations.description: Groups form fields, collects their values, and coordinates validation.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra class names appended to the root element.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name for the form region.

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: How field labels sit relative to their controls.

inputs.name: initialValues
inputs.description: Initial values, keyed by field name.

inputs.name: onValuesChange
inputs.description: Called whenever a field's value changes.

inputs.name: submitting
inputs.description: Whether the form is mid-submission; disables its controls.

inputs.name: onSubmit
inputs.description: Called with the collected values when the form is submitted and valid.

inputs.name: onReset
inputs.description: Called when the user resets the form.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Submit and cancel controls, shown after the fields.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Runs validation and returns the result.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits the form as though the submit control were activated.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restores every field to its initial value.

methods.name: focusFirstError
methods.description: Moves focus to the first field with an error.

cssParts.name: fields
cssParts.description:
The container the fields render into.
The controlled vocabulary has no term for a field group, so this component carries no
`@acmSemantic` — an absent classification is honest, a wrong one is not.

examples.title: Composing fields
Submitting state

declarations.name: Spinner
declarations.description: Indicates that work is in progress and its duration is unknown.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra class names appended to the root element.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Text announced to assistive technology while the spinner is visible.

semantics.notes: Indeterminate progress; use a determinate meter when a percentage is known.

examples.title: Inline loading state
examples.source: const busy = <Spinner size="small" label="Loading results" />;

declarations.name: Tabs
declarations.description: A tabbed container that shows one panel at a time.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra class names appended to the root element.

inputs.name: onSelectedIndexChange
inputs.description: Called with the new index when the active tab changes.

slots.name: tablist
slots.description: The tab triggers, rendered above the active panel.

semantics.notes: Switches between sibling panels; only one panel is visible at a time.

examples.title: Controlled selection

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra class names appended to the root element.

inputs.name: hint
inputs.description: Explanatory text shown below the control.

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: Validation message; presence puts the field in its error state.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Whether the control must be filled before submission.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Placeholder shown while the control is empty.

inputs.name: onValueChange
inputs.description: Called on every keystroke with the new value.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Moves keyboard focus into the control.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the control and notifies listeners.

cssProperties.name: --tb-field-border
cssProperties.description: Border colour in the resting state.

semantics.notes: Collects one line of free text; the label names what is collected.

examples.title: Required email field
Search variant in an error state
examples.source: const search = <TextField label="Search" type="search" error="No results for that term." />;

declarations.name: Tooltip
declarations.description: Shows a short explanatory label when its trigger is hovered or focused.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Extra class names appended to the root element.

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: Text shown in the tooltip bubble.

inputs.name: placement
inputs.description: Preferred side of the trigger to render on.

inputs.name: openDelay
inputs.description: Delay before the tooltip appears, in milliseconds.

semantics.notes: Supplementary label for its trigger; never the only source of information.
